cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll rebuild the cancelled wedding bookings. Give the couples replacement dates, please, not a running commentary on the fault.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cancellation log has your initials.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's an internal record. Keep it on this screen; send only confirmed dates. Client information first, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restore button puts everything back, but the email names whoever cancelled it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then don't use restore. Enter new bookings from the original dates; I'll read them out. Send new confirmations, please, not cancellation histories.

heightening.evidence: B4 named restore email causes A5 abandoning restore and manually recreating bookings.
